evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports a single evaluation result for this model: a loss of 0.6555 on the evaluation set.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: fine-tuned on Magpie-generated multilingual instruction-tuning datasets; Magpie data is LLM-generated and the card reports only a loss, so hallucination risk from synthetic training data is plausible

possible_risks.description: A metric selected to measure or track a risk is incorrectly selected, incompletely measuring the risk, or measuring the wrong risk for the given context.
possible_risks.justification: the only reported evaluation is a loss of 0.6555 on the evaluation set, which does not measure hallucination, safety, or other risk-relevant behaviors

possible_risks.description: Determining who is responsible for an AI model is challenging without good documentation and governance processes. The use of synthetic data in model development adds further complexity, since the lack of standardized frameworks for recording synthetic data design choices and verification steps makes accountability harder to establish.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight checkpoint with license listed only as 'other' and no documentation of governance or synthetic-data verification steps

specifications.model_size: 6.3 GiB of safetensors weights (6,794,256,992 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model applies UNA to MLPs at layers 4, 10, 16, 22, and 28, and MGS on 3 scales.
training_context.training_data: The model was trained on two Magpie-generated multilingual instruction-tuning datasets: Magpie-Align/Magpie-Llama-3.1-Pro-MT-300K-Filtered and Magpie-Align/Magpie-Pro-MT-300K-v0.1.
